important_dates.time of reporting: 9:30 am to 11:00 am (Gate will be closed by 11:00 am)

application_fee.details: Candidates are not required to pay any application fees.

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for the Project Assistant-II position is 35 years. Upper age limit shall be reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | project assistant-ii (1.2 pa-ii): B.Sc. in Environmental Science

salary_details.pay_scale: ₹20,000 + HRA with an increment of 15% after 3 years of experience in the same project
salary_details.project assistant-ii (1.2 pa-ii): ₹20,000 + HRA with an increment of 15% after 3 years of experience in the same project

selection_process: Selection will be done on the basis of a walk-in interview at CSIR-NEERI
how_to_apply: Download the application form attached with the official advertisement.
Fill in all the required details in the application form accurately.
Affix a passport-size photograph and sign across it.
Compile original and one set of photocopies of required documents including Aadhaar card, 10th (SSC), 12th (HSC), Graduate mark sheets, and Degree certificate.
Report for the walk-in interview at CSIR-NEERI, Nehru Marg, Near Ajni Square, Nagpur - 440020 on 21st October 2026 between 9:30 am and 11:00 am. Note that the gate will be closed by 11:00 am.
important_instructions: The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the aforementioned projects. Engagement in these projects will not confer any right implicit or explicit for consideration of regularization against any CSIR/CSIR-NEERI post(s). Under no circumstances will the tenure of project staff who have served CSIR-NEERI or any other CSIR laboratories under contract R&D projects be allowed to exceed six or seven years as per applicable CSIR OM clauses. No TA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview. Selected candidates shall have to make their own arrangement for accommodation during their tenure in the project, though HRA is admissible as per applicable rules. Selected candidates must sign an undertaking for maintaining confidentiality of project findings and/or intellectual property information. Mere fulfilling of minimum qualification does not confer any right in a candidate for being called for interview. If a large number of applications are received, preference will be given based on screening committee criteria.

content_sections.text: The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the aforementioned projects. Engagement in these projects will not confer any right implicit or explicit for consideration of regularization against any CSIR/CSIR-NEERI post(s). Under no circumstances will the tenure of project staff who have served CSIR-NEERI or any other CSIR laboratories under contract R&D projects be allowed to exceed six or seven years as per applicable CSIR OM clauses. No TA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview. Selected candidates shall have to make their own arrangement for accommodation during their tenure in the project, though HRA is admissible as per applicable rules. Selected candidates must sign an undertaking for maintaining confidentiality of project findings and/or intellectual property information. Mere fulfilling of minimum qualification does not confer any right in a candidate for being called for interview. If a large number of applications are received, preference will be given based on screening committee criteria.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for this notification?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the CSIR-National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-NEERI), Nagpur.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being recruited through this advertisement?
faq.answer: CSIR-NEERI is recruiting for the Project Assistant-II (1.2 PA-II) position under an externally funded project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant-II position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 21st October 2026, with reporting time between 9:30 am and 11:00 am.

faq.question: Q5. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at CSIR-NEERI, Nehru Marg, Near Ajni Square, Nagpur - 440020.

faq.question: Q6. What is the essential qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. in Environmental Science.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive ₹20,000 + HRA with an increment of 15% after 3 years of experience in the same project.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: Candidates are not required to pay any application fees.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this engagement is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, and it does not confer any right to regularization against any CSIR/CSIR-NEERI post.
